candidates.change_summary: Replace the hardcoded target address with address(0) so the call always succeeds and sends value nowhere, altering the flow of funds.
Remove the untagged statement block that calls target and conditionally reverts, so msg.value stays in the contract and is later transferred to owner.
Delete the transfer to owner, so after the call balances remain locked in the contract instead of being sent to owner.
Replace msg.value with 0 in the target.call value, so no Ether is forwarded during the external call but the full balance is later transferred to owner.
Replace the revert on call failure with an empty block, so a failed external call does not revert the transaction and the owner still receives the contract balance.
Replace the owner with target in the transfer call, so the contract balance is sent to the hardcoded address instead of the owner.
